title: Phase 55W applies the corpus publication and usability gate
summary: FTFN reviewed 45 signal records, promoted twelve bounded records, held twenty-seven review-shelf records, reconfirmed six Published controls, published Research Watch 001 and Local Authorization Is Not Operation, expanded reader pathways to fifteen, separated the research document shelf, strengthened signal and source filtering, and added stable research and pathway exports.
evidence_note: The gate records twelve promotions, twenty-seven holds, six Published control confirmations, and ten briefing or dependency-map decisions. Promotions remain stage-bounded; proposals, dated future events, unconfirmed company milestones, broad watch rails, and unresolved project outcomes remain In Review.
